mapper.select: SELECT JSONExtractString(ifNull(row.METADATA, '{}'), 'image_id') AS image_id, JSONExtractBool(ifNull(row.METADATA, '{}'), 'can_serve_tiles') AS can_serve_tiles, JSONExtractString(ifNull(row.METADATA, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'source_url') AS source_url, JSONExtractRaw(ifNull(row.METADATA, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'tile_metadata_json') AS tile_metadata_json, JSONExtractString(ifNull(row.METADATA, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'thumbnail_url') AS thumbnail_url, JSONExtract(ifNull(row.METADATA, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'thumbnail_width', 'Nullable(UInt32)') AS thumbnail_width, JSONExtract(ifNull(row.METADATA, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'thumbnail_height', 'Nullable(UInt32)') AS thumbnail_height, JSONExtractString(ifNull(row.METADATA, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'thumbnail_content_type') AS thumbnail_content_type FROM resource_data row PREWHERE row.CANCER_STUDY_ID = #{studyInternalId} AND row.RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND row.PATIENT_ID = #{patientId} AND row.RESOURCE_DATA_ID = #{resourceDataId} WHERE row.RESOURCE_ID IN ('WSI_SAMPLE', 'WSI_PATIENT') AND row.TYPE = 'WHOLE_SLIDE_IMAGE' LIMIT 1
